text_en: And after getting into a boat he crossed the sea and came to his own town.
text_cn: 耶稣上船过海，来到了自己的城。

text_en: And just then some people were carrying a paralyzed man lying on a bed. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven. ”
text_cn: 看，有人给他送来一个躺在床上的瘫子，耶稣一见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：“孩子，你放心！你的罪赦了。”

text_en: Then some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man is blaspheming. ”
text_cn: 经师中有几个人心里说：“这人说了亵渎的话。”

text_en: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?
text_cn: 耶稣看透他们的心意，说：“你们为什么心里思念恶事呢？

text_en: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven, ’ or to say, ‘Stand up and walk’?
text_cn: 什么比较容易呢？是说：你的罪赦了，或是说：起来行走吧？

text_en: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he then said to the paralytic—“Stand up, take your bed and go to your home. ”
text_cn: 为叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄──就对瘫子说：起来，拿起你的床，回家去吧！”

text_en: And he stood up and went to his home.
text_cn: “那人就起来，回家去了。”

text_en: When the crowds saw it, they were filled with awe, and they glorified God, who had given such authority to human beings.
text_cn: 群众见了，就都害怕起来，遂归光荣于天主，因他赐给了人们这样大的权柄。

text_en: As Jesus was walking along, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax booth; and he said to him, “Follow me. ” And he got up and followed him.
text_cn: 耶稣从那里前行，看见一个人在税关那里坐着，名叫玛窦，对他说：“跟随我！”他就起来跟随了耶稣。

text_en: And as he sat at dinner in the house, many tax collectors and sinners came and were sitting with him and his disciples.
text_cn: 当耶稣在屋里坐席时，有许多税吏和罪人也来同耶稣和他的门徒一起坐席。

text_en: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners? ”
text_cn: 法利塞人看见，就对他的门徒说：“你们的老师为什么同税吏和罪人一起进食呢？”

text_en: But when he heard this, he said, “Those who are well have no need of a physician, but those who are sick.
text_cn: 耶稣听见了，就说：“不是健康的人需要医生，而是有病的人。

text_en: Go and learn what this means, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice. ’ For I have come to call not the righteous but sinners. ”
text_cn: 你们去研究一下：‘我喜欢仁爱胜过祭献’是什么意思；我不是来召义人，而是来召罪人。”

text_en: Then the disciples of John came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples do not fast? ”
text_cn: 那时，若翰的门徒来到他跟前说：“为什么我们和法利塞人多次禁食，而你的门徒却不禁食呢？”

text_en: And Jesus said to them, “The wedding guests cannot mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them, can they? The days will come when the bridegroom is taken away from them, and then they will fast.
text_cn: 耶稣对他们说：“伴郎岂能当新郎与他们在一起的时候悲哀？ 但日子将要来到：当新郎从他们中被劫去时，那时他们就要禁食了。

text_en: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old cloak, for the patch pulls away from the cloak, and a worse tear is made.
text_cn: 没有人用未漂过的布作补钉，补在旧衣服上的，因为补上的扯裂了旧衣，破绽就更加坏了。

text_en: Neither is new wine put into old wineskins; otherwise, the skins burst, and the wine is spilled, and the skins are destroyed; but new wine is put into fresh wineskins, and so both are preserved. ”
text_cn: 也没有人把新酒装入旧皮囊里的；不然，皮囊一破裂，酒也流了，皮囊也坏了；而是应把新酒装在新皮囊里，两样就都得保全。”

text_en: While he was saying these things to them, suddenly a leader of the synagogue came in and knelt before him, saying, “My daughter has just died; but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live. ”
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说这话的时候，有一位首长前来跪拜他说：“我的女儿刚才死了，可是请你来，把你的手放在她身上，她必会活。”

text_en: And Jesus got up and followed him, with his disciples.
text_cn: 耶稣起来跟他去了；他的门徒也跟了去。

text_en: Then suddenly a woman who had been suffering from hemorrhages for twelve years came up behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak,
text_cn: 看，有一个患血漏十二年的女人，从后面走近，摸了他的衣服穗头，

text_en: for she said to herself, “If I only touch his cloak, I will be made well. ”
text_cn: 因为她心里想：“只要我一摸他的衣服，我就会好了。”

text_en: Jesus turned, and seeing her he said, “Take heart, daughter; your faith has made you well. ” And instantly the woman was made well.
text_cn: 耶稣转过身来，看着她说：“女儿，放心吧！你的信德救了你。”从那时起，那女人就好了。

text_en: When Jesus came to the leader’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd making a commotion,
text_cn: 耶稣来到首长家里，看见吹笛的和乱哄哄的群众，

text_en: he said, “Go away; for the girl is not dead but sleeping. ” And they laughed at him.
text_cn: 就说：“你们走开吧！女孩子没有死，只是睡着了。”他们都讥笑他。

text_en: But when the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took her by the hand, and the girl got up.
text_cn: 把群众赶出去以后，耶稣就进去，拿起女孩子的手，小女孩就起来了。

text_en: And the report of this spread throughout that district.
text_cn: 这消息传遍了那整个地区。

text_en: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed him, crying loudly, “Have mercy on us, Son of David! ”
text_cn: 耶稣从那里前行，有两个瞎子跟着他喊说：“达味之子！可怜我们吧！”

text_en: When he entered the house, the blind men came to him; and Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this? ” They said to him, “Yes, Lord. ”
text_cn: 他一来到家，瞎子便走到他跟前；耶稣对他们说：“你们信我能作这事吗？”他们对他说：“是，主！”

text_en: Then he touched their eyes and said, “According to your faith let it be done to you. ”
text_cn: 于是耶稣摸他们的眼说：“照你们的信德，给你们成就吧！”

text_en: And their eyes were opened. Then Jesus sternly ordered them, “See that no one knows of this. ”
text_cn: 他们的眼便开了。耶稣严厉警戒他们说：“你们当心，不要使任何人知道。”

text_en: But they went away and spread the news about him throughout that district.
text_cn: 但他们出去，就在那整个地区把他传扬开了。

text_en: After they had gone away, a demoniac who was mute was brought to him.
text_cn: 他们出去后，看，有人给耶稣送来一个附魔的哑巴。

text_en: And when the demon had been cast out, the one who had been mute spoke; and the crowds were amazed and said, “Never has anything like this been seen in Israel. ”
text_cn: 魔鬼一被赶出去，哑巴就说出话来。群众惊奇说：“在以色列从未出现过这样的事情。”

text_en: But the Pharisees said, “By the ruler of the demons he casts out the demons. ”
text_cn: 但法利塞人们却说：“他是仗赖魔王驱魔。”

text_en: Then Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and proclaiming the good news of the kingdom, and curing every disease and every sickness.
text_cn: 耶稣周游各城各村，在他们的会堂内施教，宣讲天国的福音，治好一切疾病，一切灾殃。

text_en: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion for them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
text_cn: 他一见到群众，就对他们动了慈心，因为他们困苦流离，像没有牧人的羊。

text_en: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the laborers are few;
text_cn: 于是对自己的门徒说：“庄稼固多，工人却少，

text_en: therefore ask the Lord of the harvest to send out laborers into his harvest. ”
text_cn: 所以你们应当求庄稼的主人派遣工人，来收他的庄稼。”
